item.title: Australia: AI-Powered Meal Plans Boost Weight Loss Success
item.description: CSIRO research shows that personalised meal plans, now enhanced with AI, significantly improve weight loss outcomes for Australians, supporting healthier habits, sustainable results and tailored nutrition strategies.

item.title: India: Smart Technology Drives Dairy Sector Transformation
item.description: India’s dairy sector is undergoing a major digital transformation, using technology to improve livestock management, milk collection, processing, logistics and data-driven operational and strategic decision-making.

item.title: Singapore: AI Challenge Launched to Tackle Chronic Diseases
item.description: Singapore’s AI Innovation Challenge 2026 engages students in developing multilingual, culturally aware AI solutions using MERaLiON and SEA-LION to detect, prevent and effectively manage chronic diseases.

item.title: Australia: SharkSmart Drones Boost Queensland Beach Safety
item.description: Queensland’s expanded SharkSmart drone programme uses real-time aerial surveillance to enhance beach safety, detect sharks early, protect swimmers effectively and support non-lethal marine risk management.

item.title: India Strengthens Cybersecurity and Digital Infrastructure
item.description: India is strengthening cybersecurity, safeguarding citizen data and leveraging advanced digital infrastructure like NICDC to drive a secure, efficient, resilient, innovative, inclusive and globally competitive economy.

item.title: Malaysia: Selangor Aerospace Soars with Advanced Manufacturing
item.description: Selangor is rapidly advancing as Malaysia’s aerospace hub by adopting automation, IoT and digital tech while developing a highly skilled workforce to strengthen its global aviation supply chain role.

item.title: Vietnam: Institutional Reform Drives Hanoi’s Smart Development
item.description: Hanoi’s development requires a strong legal framework, institutional reform and a clear focus on digital transformation, science, technology, innovation, creativity and sustainability to drive high-quality growth.

item.title: Hong Kong Expands Urban Trials to Advance Intelligent Mobility
item.description: Hong Kong is expanding real-world autonomous vehicle trials across urban districts, rigorously testing advanced mobility technologies to improve traffic efficiency, enhance road safety and ensure reliability under local conditions.

item.title: The Philippines: DICT Strengthens Digital Access for Learners
item.description: DICT’s Bayanihan SIM Project is actively enhancing digital access for students and teachers in remote communities of Soccsksargen and Davao Region, bridging the connectivity gap and supporting online learning.

item.title: Singapore, Japan Sign Landmark Quantum Cooperation Agreement
item.description: The first government-level quantum cooperation agreement establishes a framework to advance research, talent development and commercialisation across the regional quantum ecosystem.
